The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `2113` (see `KurrentDbBuilder.KurrentDbPort`)
- Environment variable: `KURRENTDB_CLUSTER_SIZE=1`
- Environment variable: `KURRENTDB_RUN_PROJECTIONS=All`
- Environment variable: `KURRENTDB_START_STANDARD_PROJECTIONS=true`
- Environment variable: `KURRENTDB_INSECURE=true`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the container is healthy.
